The historic rivalry between Lazio and Inter took center stage this weekend in a match filled with tactical intrigue and individual brilliance. Both clubs entered the pitch on May 9, 2026 , looking to secure vital points in the race for Serie A supremacy. Inter Take an Early Stride The contest began with high energy, but it was Inter who quickly dictated the tempo at the Stadio Olimpico . In just the 6th minute, the visitors broke the deadlock with a clinical team move. Yann Aurel Bisseck initiated the play that found Marcus Thuram , who provided the delivery for Lautaro Martinez . The Argentine captain made no mistake, volleying the ball into the back of the net with his right foot to give his side the perfect start. Lazio struggled to find their rhythm as the Nerazzurri defense held firm. The pressure from the visitors told again in the 39th minute when they doubled their lead. Petar Sucic , who would go on to be a standout performer, received an assist from Lautaro Martinez and unleashed a powerful left-footed strike from outside the box. The ball flew past the keeper, leaving the home side with a mountain to climb before the interval. Red Card Drama and Lazio's Struggle The second half saw tactical adjustments from both sides, but the complexion of the game changed drastically in the 59th minute. Following a serious foul, Alessio Romagnoli was initially shown a yellow card, but after a VAR review, the referee upgraded the decision to a straight red. Reduced to ten men, Lazio faced an uphill battle to salvage anything from the encounter. Despite the disadvantage, the home side nearly pulled one back in the 61st minute. Gustav Isaksen managed to get a shot away, but his effort was heroically hacked off the goal line by the Inter defense. The visitors then utilized their numerical superiority to control possession, effectively suffocating any potential comeback attempt from the Roman club. Mkhitaryan Seals the Points Any hope of a late miracle for the hosts was extinguished in the 76th minute. Ange-Yoan Bonny , introduced as a substitute, turned provider for Henrikh Mkhitaryan . The veteran midfielder found space and fired a left-footed shot into the net to make it 3-0. Inter finished the match with 57% possession, calmly seeing out the final minutes as Petar Sucic orchestrated the midfield to ensure a convincing and deserved victory on the road.

A well-orchestrated move saw Jurgen Ekkelenkamp provide a precise delivery for Kingsley Ehizibue , who caught the defense stationary. Ehizibue met the ball with a perfectly timed right-footed volley that flew into the back of the net, silencing the home crowd and giving the visitors a precious lead. Following the opening goal, Lazio struggled to find an immediate answer. The first half grew increasingly physical, evidenced by a yellow card shown to Matteo Cancellieri for a reckless challenge. Despite several corners delivered by Tijjani Noslin and Toma Basic , the Udinese backline held firm. The visitors nearly doubled their lead through an Ekkelenkamp free kick, but the effort sailed wide, leaving the score at 1-0 heading into the break. Tactical Shifts and the Biancocelesti Fightback Lazio manager responded to the deficit by introducing Pedro and Fisayo Dele-Bashiru at the start of the second half, a move that immediately injected urgency into their play. The pressure paid off in the 50th minute when Luca Pellegrini produced a moment of magic. Following a corner sequence, Pellegrini found space to unleash a left-footed volley that beat Maduka Okoye , leveling the score at 1-1. The goal-scorer's joy was short-lived, however, as he soon found himself in the referee's book for unsportsmanlike conduct after a heated exchange. As the match entered the final ten minutes, the tactical battle intensified. In the 80th minute, Lazio appeared to have completed the comeback. Toma Basic found Pedro just outside the penalty area; the veteran Spaniard took a touch and unleashed a clinical right-footed strike from distance that nestled into the corner of the net. With the score at 2-1, the home fans celebrated what they believed was the winning moment, but the drama was only just beginning. A Frantic Finish at the Death Udinese refused to surrender and turned to their bench for inspiration, a move that bore fruit in the 86th minute. Substitute Arthur Atta found space in the box and expertly guided a left-footed shot past Edoardo Motta to restore parity. The visitors weren't finished yet. In the third minute of stoppage time, Vakoun Issouf Bayo played a pivotal role, setting up Atta for his second of the night. This time using his right foot, Atta completed a stunning turnaround to put Udinese 3-2 ahead, seemingly snatching all three points in the dying moments. However, the Olimpico had one final twist in store. In the 95th minute, Pedro turned provider, lofting a cross that found Daniel Maldini . The substitute controlled the ball and fired home a right-footed shot to make it 3-3. The goal was immediately subject to a lengthy VAR review for a potential infringement, but after several tense minutes, the referee confirmed the goal stood. Amidst the chaos, Patric received a yellow card for his role in the post-goal celebrations. The final whistle blew shortly after, concluding a breathtaking encounter where neither side could be separated despite a combined four goals in the final quarter-hour.

The Stadio Olimpico crackled with anticipation on May 17, 2026 , as AS Roma and Lazio prepared to write the latest chapter in their historic Serie A rivalry. Mancini Rises to the Occasion The match began with the high-octane intensity expected of a Derby della Capitale, with both sides trading tactical blows in a cagey opening period. The deadlock was finally broken in the 40th minute when AS Roma exploited their strength from set-pieces. Niccolo Pisilli delivered a pinpoint corner from the left, finding the forehead of Gianluca Mancini , who powered his header home. There was a brief moment of silence as VAR checked the goal's validity, but the referee eventually pointed to the center circle to confirm the lead. Tempers flared shortly after, with Mario Hermoso and Matteo Cancellieri both receiving yellow cards for unsportsmanlike conduct as the first half drew to a close. Double Delight and Lazio Discipline Crumbles Roma continued to apply pressure in the second half, and the script repeated itself in the 66th minute. This time, it was Paulo Dybala who provided the ammunition from a corner on the left, swinging a dangerous ball into the box for Gianluca Mancini to once again outleap the defense and head into the net. The momentum shifted even more dramatically in the 70th minute when the match descended into chaos. Following an outbreak of violent conduct, the referee issued straight red cards to both Wesley and Nicolo Rovella , leaving Lazio to navigate the final twenty minutes with only nine men on the pitch. Late Woodwork and Closing Stages Despite being two men down, Lazio attempted to remain compact, but AS Roma pushed for a third to put the game completely out of reach. Artem Dovbyk , introduced as a substitute for Dybala , came agonisingly close in the 89th minute when his well-struck effort rattled the post. In the dying embers of the game, Matias Soule forced a save from Alessio Furlanetto , and Jan Ziolkowski saw a header fly wide. As the final whistle blew, the Giallorossi celebrated a hard-fought victory defined by Mancini's aerial dominance and a total disciplinary collapse from their cross-town rivals.
